list.name: app

panels.title: 01 · 全数据源样本检查 — 不能代表每个采集目标健康
panels.description: 检查整个数据源是否存在各类核心指标，不代表 exporter 当前健康或全部目标齐全。缺失为 0，不给业务指标补零。

panels.title: Kubernetes 对象状态
panels.description: 在所选 Prometheus 数据源全范围检查该指标族是否有近期样本，不受命名空间、应用、节点、Pod 或容器筛选影响。1=存在样本，0=未检测到；不能据此判断每个目标健康，应用采集健康见服务总览。

panels.title: 02 · 存活与异常 — 对象状态、重启与副本缺口
panels.description: 对象状态来自 kube-state-metrics。Running 不等于 Ready；无数据不是零。

panels.title: Ready 节点
panels.description: 仅受节点筛选影响，集群整机对象。 同卡并列显示当前状态数量与所选对象总数；总数不是控制器期望副本。应用筛选仅用于应用埋点，不过滤 Kubernetes 对象。

panels.title: Running Pod
panels.description: 受命名空间、节点、Pod筛选影响；不受容器筛选影响。 同卡并列显示当前状态数量与所选对象总数；总数不是控制器期望副本。应用筛选仅用于应用埋点，不过滤 Kubernetes 对象。

panels.title: Ready Pod
panels.description: 当前可服务的 Pod 数；不是副本期望值。 同卡并列显示当前状态数量与所选对象总数；总数不是控制器期望副本。应用筛选仅用于应用埋点，不过滤 Kubernetes 对象。

panels.title: 运行中容器
panels.description: 普通容器，不包含 init container；Running 不等于应用健康。 同卡并列显示当前状态数量与所选对象总数；总数不是控制器期望副本。应用筛选仅用于应用埋点，不过滤 Kubernetes 对象。

panels.title: 等待中容器
panels.description: 等待原因见异常列表；零值仅来自真实状态序列。

panels.title: 窗口重启次数
panels.description: 在所选窗口结束点计算 increase 估算，可能有小数；只统计仍能关联当前 Pod 身份的容器，不是完整历史重启事件清单，也不等于容器存活数。

panels.title: 未 Ready Pod（排除 Succeeded）
panels.description: 仅列 Ready=false 的 Pod，排除已成功完成的 Pod；Failed/Pending 等保留以便排障。空表须结合样本可用性判断。受命名空间、节点、Pod 筛选影响，独立于应用与容器筛选。 包含 Pending、Running、Failed、Unknown；Failed 是已终止对象，不代表仍在执行。

targets.expr: ((max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",condition="true"}) == 0) unless on (namespace,pod) (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Succeeded"}) == 1)) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))

panels.title: 当前等待原因
panels.description: 仅列当前等待原因，如 CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff；无异常时列表为空。

panels.title: 未 Ready 节点
panels.description: 仅列 Ready=false/unknown 的节点，保留状态便于区分；空表可能为无异常或指标缺失，结合首区样本检查。只受节点筛选影响。

panels.title: 最近一次终止为 OOMKilled
panels.description: 可选 kube-state-metrics 指标；仅列最近一次容器终止原因仍为 OOMKilled 的对象，不能解释为所选窗口内 OOM 次数或当前 OOM。空表可能为无记录或指标未启用。

panels.title: 节点压力与 Ready 异常
panels.description: 1 表示压力或非 Ready；Ready unknown 也作为异常。只受节点筛选影响。 时间线 0=正常、1=异常；无样本断开，不延续旧状态。

panels.title: Pod 阶段时间线
panels.description: 每行一个 namespace/Pod，展示当前有效 phase；状态不随视图或容器筛选聚合，避免多个 Pod 的阶段数被误解为单一状态。无样本断开，不延续旧状态。

targets.expr: ((1 * (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Pending"}) == 1)) or (2 * (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Running"}) == 1)) or (3 * (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Succeeded"}) == 1)) or (4 * (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Failed"}) == 1)) or (5 * (max by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",phase="Unknown"}) == 1))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))

panels.title: 重启次数（所选时间窗口）
panels.description: 仅在所选时间窗口结束点计算 increase[$__range]，按视图排序展示窗口总量；可能有小数。已消失且无当前 Pod 身份样本的容器无法关联，不作为完整历史事件清单。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__range]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: Deployment 期望与可用副本（命名空间）
panels.description: 可选 kube-state-metrics Deployment 指标；仅受命名空间与 Deployment 筛选影响，不受节点、Pod、容器或应用筛选影响。可用副本不等于 Pod Ready；缺口=max(期望-可用,0)，缺失指标保留空值。

panels.title: 03 · 工作负载资源 — 展开按视图下钻
panels.description: Pod / Container / Node / Instance（Pod IP）决定聚合口径。Node 视图这里是所选容器之和，不是整机资源。

panels.title: CPU 使用量
panels.description: cAdvisor 普通容器 CPU，排除空容器和 POD sandbox；Pod 视图包含所选容器。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 内存工作集
panels.description: Working Set，不是进程 RSS；Pod 视图为所选容器工作集之和。

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

targets.expr: (sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))) / (sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip")) > 0)

targets.expr: sum by (${view:raw}) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(((max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",container=~"${container}",container!="",container!="POD"})) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(node,pod_ip) (max by (namespace,pod,node,pod_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"${namespace}",pod=~"${pod}",node=~"${node}"}))), "view_pod", " / ", "namespace", "pod"), "view_container", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "container"), "view_node", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "view_node", "未调度", "node", "^$"), "view_instance", " / ", "namespace", "pod", "pod_ip"))

panels.title: 04 · 节点资源 — 整机口径与文件系统定位
panels.description: 本区只受节点筛选影响，忽略命名空间、Pod、容器和视图。包含系统进程、所有工作负载及其他主机开销。

panels.title: 节点 CPU 使用率
panels.description: 1 - idle，各逻辑 CPU 求平均；不是 Pod CPU。node_uname_info 的 node 或 nodename 须对应 Kubernetes 节点名。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点内存使用率
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal；只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((1 - max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点 Load 15m / CPU 核数
panels.description: Load 15m 除以去重后的逻辑 CPU 核数，1 表示负载等于核数；不是 CPU 使用率。只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((max by (instance) (node_load15) / count by (instance) (max by (instance,cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点最满文件系统
panels.description: 各节点已采集且容量大于零的文件系统最高使用率；同 instance/device/mountpoint/fstype 去重。下方 Top 10 表保留挂载点和可用空间用于定位。只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: max by (node) (((1 - (max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) / ((max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) > 0))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"}))

panels.title: 文件系统使用率 Top 10
panels.description: 按当前使用率排序，仅列筛选节点内 Top 10 物理文件系统，保留节点、设备、挂载点、类型与可用空间。排除临时/容器挂载；容量为零或缺失时不伪造使用率。只受节点筛选影响。

targets.expr: topk(10, ((1 - (max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) / ((max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) > 0))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"}))

((max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})) and on (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype,node) (topk(10, ((1 - (max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) / ((max by (instance,device,mountpoint,fstype) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs",mountpoint!~"/run.*|/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.*"})) > 0))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})))

panels.title: 节点网络
panels.description: 主机设备总量；bond/bridge 或设备映射可能重复计算，需按实际设备拓扑调整过滤。 同 instance/device 先对采集副本去重再按节点求和。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (max by (instance,device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (max by (instance,device) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 节点磁盘吞吐
panels.description: 主机设备总量；bond/bridge 或设备映射可能重复计算，需按实际设备拓扑调整过滤。 同 instance/device 先对采集副本去重再按节点求和。

targets.expr: max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (max by (instance,device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

max by (node) ((sum by (instance) (max by (instance,device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left(node) (max by (instance,node) (node_uname_info{node!=""} or label_replace(node_uname_info{node=""}, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))) and on (node) max by (node) (kube_node_info{node=~"${node}"})

panels.title: 06 · 应用指标简表 — 完整入口见服务总览
panels.description: 本区是应用埋点，不是 cAdvisor 指标。需 namespace、container 和 pod_name（或在“应用 Pod 标签”选择 pod）。应用指标通过 namespace/pod 关联节点。
